user.title: ESB Lights
user.description: Connect to the internal ESB Lights API. Enter the address of the server running it — a bare host like 192.168.123.114:4000 is fine.

data.api_key: API key (leave blank if the API doesn't require one)
data.scan_interval: Check for a new colour every (seconds)

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the API at that address. Check the host and port, and that Home Assistant's network can reach it.
error.unexpected_response: That address answered, but not with ESB Lights data. Check you've got the right host.

abort.already_configured: That API address is already set up.
